faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Write to us and we'll answer.

credit-card.question: Do I need a credit card to get started?
credit-card.answer: No. You can create your account and start logging transactions without entering any payment method.

how-ai-works.question: How does AI categorization work?
how-ai-works.answer: When you log a transaction without picking a category, the system sends the description and amount to a language model that automatically classifies it into the most suitable category, along with a confidence score.

data-security.question: Is my financial data safe?
data-security.answer: Yes. Passwords are stored with bcrypt hashing, sessions use short-lived JWTs, and all communication with the server is encrypted.

export-reports.question: Can I export my reports?
export-reports.answer: Yes, you can generate reports filtered by period and export them as CSV or PDF to share with your accountant or team.

any-business.question: Does it work for any type of business?
any-business.answer: FinFlowIA is built for small businesses and independent professionals. The built-in categories cover the most common cases, and you can add your own if your business needs them.

mobile-usage.question: Can I use it from my phone?
mobile-usage.answer: Yes, the app is fully responsive: you can log an expense the moment it happens and check your dashboard from any device.
